lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sram karate dam aadh kau te ganee dhaneetaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan vadaaee kahi sakau bea(n)t guneetaa ||
lines.translation: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi naam dehu naanak daras reetaa ||4||7||37||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh parabaad neet lobh rasanaa saad ||
lines.translation: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lapat kapat grihi bedhiaa mithiaa bikhiaad ||1||
lines.translation: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee pekhee netr mahi poore gur parasaad ||
lines.translation: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh dhan jobanaa naamai bin baad ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਸੋਗੰਧਤਾ ਕਾਪਰ ਭੋਗਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: roop dhoop soga(n)dhataa kaapar bhogaad ||
lines.translation: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: milat sa(n)g paapisat tan hoe duragaad ||2||
lines.translation: - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phirat phirat maanukh bhaiaa khin bha(n)gan dehaad ||
lines.translation: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this body lasts only for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ih ausar te chookiaa bahu jon bhramaad ||3||
lines.translation: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kirapaa te gur mile har har bisamaad ||
lines.translation: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj naanak ana(n)d taa kai pooran naad ||4||8||38||
lines.translation: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound current of the Naad. ||4||8||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan bhae sa(n)t bohithaa tare saagar jet ||
lines.translation: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maarag paae udiaan mahi gur dase bhet ||1||
lines.translation: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of the Lord's Mystery. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har har hare har har har het ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sovate har har har chet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch chor aagai bhage jab saadhasa(n)get ||
lines.translation: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee saabat ghano laabh grihi sobhaa set ||2||
lines.translation: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal aasan mitee chi(n)t naahee dolet ||
lines.translation: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulaavaa mit gaiaa prabh pekhat net ||3||
lines.translation: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gabheer gun naaikaa gun kaheeahi ket ||
lines.translation: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of His Glorious Virtues should I speak?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paaiaa saadhasa(n)g har har a(n)mret ||4||9||39||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||4||9||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin saadhoo jo jeevanaa teto birathaaree ||
lines.translation: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: milat sa(n)g sabh bhram mite gat bhaee hamaaree ||1||
lines.translation: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa din bhete saadh mohi uaa din balihaaree ||
lines.translation: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man apano jeearaa phir phir hau vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: et chhadaaee mohi te itanee driRataaree ||
lines.translation: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sagal ren ihu man bhaiaa binasee apadhaaree ||2||
lines.translation: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)d chi(n)d par dookhanaa e khin mahi jaaree ||
lines.translation: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa maiaa ar nikat pekh naahee dooraaree ||3||
lines.translation: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man seetal bhae ab mukate sa(n)saaree ||
lines.translation: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: heet cheet sabh praan dhan naanak darasaaree ||4||10||40||
lines.translation: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahal karau tere daas kee pag jhaarau baal ||
lines.translation: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: masatak apanaa bhet deu gun sunau rasaal ||1||
lines.translation: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumh milate meraa man jeeo tumh milahu daiaal ||
lines.translation: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nis baasur man anad hot chitavat kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause||
